title: The Health and Safety (Miscellaneous Repeals, Revocations and Amendments) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2026
summary: These Regulations are made under the Health and Safety at Work (Northern Ireland) Order 1978 (“the 1978 Order”) and the Offshore, and Pipelines, Safety (Northern Ireland) Order 1992. They repeal certain provisions of the Factories Act (Northern Ireland) 1965 and the Office and Shop Premises Act (Northern Ireland) 1966. The Regulations also revoke six Instruments. The legislation being removed is either redundant or has been replaced by more recent provisions. The Regulations make minor amendments to five Statutory Rules. These repeals, revocations and amendments were the subject of a public Consultation in accordance with Article 46(3) of the 1978 Order.

title: The Gas Safety (Management) (Amendment) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Gas Safety (Management) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1997 (S.R. 1997 No. 195) (“the 1997 Regulations”). The 1997 Regulations provide for the preparation and acceptance of safety cases in respect of the conveyance of gas in a network and impose requirements in respect of gas escapes and the composition and pressure of gas. With the exception of regulations 3(2)(d) and (5), 4, 5, 6(2) and (3), 7, 10, 11, 13 and the Schedule, which come into operation on 21st December 2027, these Regulations come into operation on 21st December 2026.

title: The Sussex and Brighton Combined County Authority (Transfer of Fire and Rescue Functions) Order 2026
summary: This Order provides for the conferral of the functions of the East Sussex Fire Authority (“the ESFA”) and the West Sussex County Council as a fire and rescue Authority (“the WSFRA”) (together “the existing FRAs”) on the Sussex and Brighton Combined County Authority (“the SBCCA”).

title: The Surrey Fire and Rescue Authority (Combination Scheme) Order 2026
summary: This Order makes a scheme which combines the areas of the East Surrey and West Surrey Councils (“the Councils”) into a combined area and creates a fire and rescue authority for that area. Under the Fire and Rescue Services Act 2004, the Councils become the fire and rescue authorities for their respective areas when Surrey County Council is abolished under the Surrey (Structural Changes) Order 2026 (S.I. 2026/564) on 1st April 2027. For the purposes of this Order, they are treated as though they are already the fire and rescue authority for their respective areas. The Scheme comes into force on 15th December 2026 for transitional purposes, prior to it coming fully into operation on 1st April 2027. The fire and rescue authority for the combined area is to be known as the Surrey Combined Fire and Rescue Authority (“the Authority”). The Scheme provides for the appointment and terms of office of its members, and for meetings of the Authority. The Scheme also provides for the transfer of staff, property, rights and liabilities from the Surrey Fire and Rescue Authority to the Authority. A full regulatory impact assessment has not been prepared for this instrument as no, or no significant, impact on the private, public or voluntary sectors is foreseen.

title: The Cumbria Combined Authority (Transfer of Fire and Rescue Functions) Order 2026
summary: This Order provides for the conferral of the functions of the Cumbria Commissioner Fire and Rescue Authority (“the CCFRA”) on the Cumbria Combined Authority (“the Combined Authority”).
